stratagem.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagem.lore: Employing their steeds’ pace to utmost effect, these warriors stay ever on the move.
stratagem.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagem.effect: ▪ If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move. ▪ Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

stratagem.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
stratagem.lore: Speed and shock are key to the Space Marine way of war: never more so than on rapid-strike missions.
stratagem.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit is selected to make an advance move.
stratagem.effect: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

stratagem.name: HURTLING TARGETS
stratagem.lore: With nerves of steel and transhuman reactions, the Space Marines jink and weave cooly through incoming fire.
stratagem.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagem.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
